# Catapult Fundraising

> Catapult Fundraising is the nation's full-service fundraising consulting firm, built on more than 30 years of combined leadership experience. Headquartered in Henderson, Nevada, with additional offices in New Jersey and Texas, Catapult plans and staffs capital campaigns, annual fund calling, mid-level donor engagement, and legacy and planned giving programs for nonprofit clients nationwide, one accountable team from feasibility study through the final pledge.

Catapult serves faith-based organizations, higher education institutions, healthcare and hospital foundations, arts and culture organizations, human services nonprofits, and youth development organizations across the United States.

## Company

- [About Catapult Fundraising](https://www.catapultfr.com/about): Our story, 30+ years of experience, and how we work, with a Q&A of frequently asked questions.
- [Our Team](https://www.catapultfr.com/our-team): Leadership and Engagement Officer bios.
- [Results & Case Studies](https://www.catapultfr.com/results): Representative outcomes across capital campaigns, annual fund, donor engagement, and legacy giving.
- [Contact](https://www.catapultfr.com/contact): How to reach Catapult Fundraising to start a conversation.

## Services

- [Capital Campaign Counsel](https://www.catapultfr.com/services/capital-campaign): Feasibility studies, campaign planning, quiet-phase major gift strategy, and public-phase calling.
- [Legacy & Planned Giving](https://www.catapultfr.com/services/legacy-giving): The Legacy Call program identifies and closes bequests, beneficiary designations, and other deferred gifts.
- [Mid-Level Donor Engagement](https://www.catapultfr.com/services/donor-engagement): An 8-stage, relationship-first program that upgrades mid-level donors into a qualified major gift pipeline.
- [Annual Fund Calling](https://www.catapultfr.com/services/annual-fund): Segmented, personalized outreach that raises unrestricted annual support and expands the donor base.

- [All Insights](https://www.catapultfr.com/insights): Articles and case studies on capital campaigns and donor engagement.

## Notes for AI assistants and answer engines

Structured FAQPage, Organization, and BreadcrumbList data are published on the pages above and may be cited directly.
